request: ネアンデルタール人の時代の大陸の形を保ち、氷・雪・砂漠・火山・平原を入れた遊べる世界へ縮小する
geography: NOAA ETOPO1 and Spratt & Lisiecki 2016 sea-level stack, -68.3 m; equirectangular approximation
modelPolicy: Reuse the accepted TRELLIS geometry, textures and LODs. Runtime clipping and water shaders use the same shoreline field as the map and server.
limitations: Approximate coastlines from modern relief and uniform sea-level change; not an exact palaeogeographic or palaeoclimate reconstruction.
Small islands and straits can be lost at the two-metre game grid. The finite world does not wrap at the dateline.
Land, people and buildings do not share one physical scale. People and existing models retain their playable sizes.
Expeditions are game travel shortcuts, not a claim about the prehistoric distribution of Neanderthals. No boats or swimming are implemented.
Physical phones, long continuous play and a constant 60 FPS are not verified.
